comment: Output shaped like each CLI's for one minimal delegation (prompt: Reply with the single word: ok); fixtures of the usage parsers. usage = the expected extractUsage(stdout + stderr). IDs, paths, amounts and settings are placeholders.

codex.source: codex-cli 0.162 text output, -m gpt-6-luna; usage printed as tokens used at the end of stderr

cursor.source: cursor-agent 2026.10 JSON output; camelCase inputTokens + outputTokens, no total, cache not counted

claude.source: constructed: the field structure of claude-error.stdout.txt filled with success values; no total, input + output, cache not counted

claude-error.source: claude 2.1 JSON output of a failed run (authentication error); all-zero usage counts as none
